goal: Prevents silent connection failures to IPv6 peers when routing traffic through Tor proxies
Restores reliable outbound connectivity to roughly twenty to thirty percent of reachable IPv6 peers
agreement: Author resolved an initial suggestion by confirming the upstream Tor bug was already tracked

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it resolves silent connection failures when reaching IPv6 peers over Tor proxies
A large fraction of gossip addresses and DNS seed answers are otherwise unusable through Tor
